confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are rough, bounded estimates from aggregator sites, crowdsourced data, and a few resort-menu fragments. Sources conflict, and no Ocho Rios restaurant or bar menu was verified directly. Wine glass has no usable direct price data and is set relative to the beer anchor, with resort markups and Jamaican consumption taxes assumed. Restaurant meal anchors are medium-to-low confidence. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Ocho Rios as a resort town; no booking pages or current listings were inspected. Jamaica's inflation reportedly rose to 6.7% in June 2026, so older price guides may understate current costs. FX: the 0.6720 USD-per-AUD observation for 2026-11-18 was taken from aggregator pages that cite the RBA 4 pm fixing. The rba.gov.au exchange-rates page was not opened directly, so verify the value there before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Estimates are based on Jamaica-wide local meal price points (chicken lunch around J$1,000, mid-range mains around J$1,800-3,000) adjusted upward for Ocho Rios resort-area pricing (tourist mains around J$3,000-5,000 or more), plus a Kingston nightlife-guide bar benchmark for cocktails. Wine glass is set at about 1.5 to 2 times the beer anchor, and hotel and hostel anchors are holistic estimates for a resort town.
